name: Eiroku
source: Middle aged man working as a director (局長) of the Bonin FM station. To his utmost annoyance, he gets called "president" (社長) instead by Yuuri and Narumi, to which he utters his catchphrase-like response - "Call me director, you moron!" ("局長と呼べ、バカヤロー！).
translation: Middle aged man working as a director (局長) of the Bonin FM station. To his utmost annoyance, he gets called "president" (社長) instead by Yuuri and Narumi, to which he utters his catchphrase-like response - "Call me director, you moron!" ("局長と呼べ、バカヤロー！).
